verdict.justification: The project aims to develop a mobile application for the health and wellbeing of remote systems engineers, graduates of the Engineering Systems program at Universidad del Valle, Sede Tuluá. The application is intended to address challenges related to remote work such as lack of physical activity, poor posture, stress, and unhealthy eating habits. The project's approach is qualitative, exploring the perceptions and experiences of remote workers regarding the mobile application. The research will be based on surveys and focus groups to obtain in-depth information about subjective and contextual aspects of the application's use, allowing for adaptation and improvement according to user needs and preferences. The application will focus on providing daily personalized training sessions, promoting exercise and physical activity as part of the daily routine of systems engineers. It will also include motivational features such as virtual rewards and records, to encourage consistent use and maintain a healthy lifestyle. This project aims to fill a gap in the market by developing an innovative and customized mobile application to improve the health and wellbeing of remote systems engineers.
